name: Design Event
description: The Design Event assesses the engineering design, technical decisions, and innovation behind the vehicle. Teams present their design process, from concept development to validation and testing, supported by sound engineering reasoning and data.

name: Business Plan Event
description: The Business Plan Event challenges the team to develop and present a comprehensive business strategy for bringing the race car concept to market. It evaluates the team’s understanding of financial planning, marketing, and project viability.

name: Project Management Event
description: The Project Management Event in Formula Student UK evaluates the team’s ability to plan, organize, and manage the development of the vehicle effectively. It focuses on project scheduling, resource allocation, risk management, and team coordination.
